description: Creates or splits a 1-tap #startapp=slip_... payout link (or 12-character scrypt claim code) for paying a human contributor over Telegram, X DM, or SMS.

amount.description: Human decimal amount (e.g. "1.50") or atomic integer when amountIsAtomic is true

noTakeBack.description: Set true for permanent No take-back finality (9_999_999_999); false allows 0%-fee reclaim if unclaimed

name: cryptoslip_pay_human
